concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-guides-application-uploader-overview]] - 2026-09-16 select-merchant Bill Pay route for specially configured Control Panel bulk CSV biller-application submission, irreversible submission, error correction and later Global Credit review; not current eligibility, approval, method configuration or processing-readiness proof
warnings: Keep merchant submission, successful application creation, Underwriting or Global Credit review, approval, biller method configuration and readiness to process as separate states.

The Application Uploader is documented only for select merchants and requires special PayPal Account Manager configuration; the snapshot is not current merchant eligibility or account-enablement evidence.
Preserve the irreversible-submission warning: submitted applications cannot be edited or altered.
